title: ASCII Kinesis V2 Contact029 — Two-Stage Anchor Root-Owner Swap Gate

source.source_identity: Zangief — Super Street Fighter II: The New Challengers — Sega Genesis
observed: whole fighter sheet contains grounded/travel, compact/load, contact/grab, consequence, fall and recovery families
contact-capable states preserve a readable support base before upper-body commitment
source commentary identifies Running Bear Grab sprites and walk-tile reuse as production evidence for topology-preserving approach/acquisition
source does not provide a complete opponent performance or authentic frame exposure durations
inferred: generic partner center proxy and all partner-center motion
single-anchor drag, second-anchor root-owner swap, staggered release and all support/COM consequences
all key timing classes, authored bridge keys, overshoot, lag and displaced recovery

actors.B: generic contacted mass/partner-center proxy; opponent pose intentionally unspecified by source

direction_profile.law: Contact is acquired one anchor at a time. Root ownership cannot become SHARED until the second anchor is visibly established. Release is likewise staged TWO_ANCHORS -> ONE_ANCHOR -> RELEASED, and the final free state is illegal until A has already begun braking.
direction_profile.spacing: deliberately nonuniform: large range claim, compressed acquisition, slower single-anchor drag, fast owner-swap drive, held brake, then asymmetric overshoot/recovery
direction_profile.asymmetry: rear-loaded approach -> front-dominant transfer/brake -> rear-probe recovery; torso lean changes sign before release
direction_profile.recovery: displaced; K13 does not return to K00 root, stance, hands or partner center

keys.name: OFFSET_READY
keys.causal_role: Stable asymmetric base reads range; partner center is independent and still.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Stable asymmetric base reads range; partner center is independent and still.

keys.name: RANGE_CLAIM
keys.causal_role: Root advances farther than the hands; contact remains visibly absent.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root advances farther than the hands; contact remains visibly absent.

keys.name: SINK_ELIGIBLE
keys.causal_role: Authored preload: COM sinks behind reach, rear support loads, first anchor becomes eligible before acquisition.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Authored preload: COM sinks behind reach, rear support loads, first anchor becomes eligible before acquisition.

keys.name: ACQUIRE_SINGLE
keys.causal_role: First distal anchor lands inside committed reach; second hand remains conspicuously free.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: First distal anchor lands inside committed reach; second hand remains conspicuously free.

keys.name: SINGLE_ANCHOR_DRAG
keys.causal_role: A drives through rear support while one anchor tows B only slightly; ownership remains A.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: A drives through rear support while one anchor tows B only slightly; ownership remains A.

keys.name: SECOND_ANCHOR_SET
keys.causal_role: Second anchor closes the graph; root sinks under the contact line and ownership becomes shared.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Second anchor closes the graph; root sinks under the contact line and ownership becomes shared.

keys.name: OWNER_SWAP_BRIDGE
keys.causal_role: Bridge: rear drive shortens while front plant takes load; B begins moving because the two-anchor graph is now load-bearing.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Bridge: rear drive shortens while front plant takes load; B begins moving because the two-anchor graph is now load-bearing.

keys.name: SHARED_TURN
keys.causal_role: Shared-center transfer compresses spacing; A torso outruns pelvis while B lags one authored beat.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Shared-center transfer compresses spacing; A torso outruns pelvis while B lags one authored beat.

keys.name: BRAKE_BEFORE_RELEASE
keys.causal_role: A begins visible arrest and counterlean while both anchors remain. Release is not an endpoint shortcut.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: A begins visible arrest and counterlean while both anchors remain. Release is not an endpoint shortcut.

keys.name: DROP_SECOND_KEEP_FIRST
keys.causal_role: One anchor deliberately releases but custody persists through the first anchor; root ownership returns to A.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: One anchor deliberately releases but custody persists through the first anchor; root ownership returns to A.

keys.name: ONE_ANCHOR_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: B overshoots while the remaining anchor stretches; A recoils and rear support searches behind.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: B overshoots while the remaining anchor stretches; A recoils and rear support searches behind.

keys.name: FINAL_RELEASE_FORK
keys.causal_role: Final anchor breaks only after arrest is obvious; B continues inertially while A moves opposite.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Final anchor breaks only after arrest is obvious; B continues inertially while A moves opposite.

keys.name: CATCH_SECONDARY_LAG
keys.causal_role: A catches displaced recovery; arms and torso trail the root while B remains separated.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: A catches displaced recovery; arms and torso trail the root while B remains separated.

keys.name: DISPLACED_SETTLE
keys.causal_role: Settle remains displaced from K00; base is re-established without idle reset.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Settle remains displaced from K00; base is re-established without idle reset.
